label: Diagram 2.3
caption: Diagram 2.3
description:
Two sections, a. and b., through a three-storey dwellinghouse with a pitched roof over an 'Unoccupied space' and a grey 'Protected stairway' down the right-hand side, enclosed by 'Fire resisting enclosure to protected stairway REI 30'. Each has a '4.5m' dimension rising from ground level. See para 2.5.

In a., the stairway and its enclosure continue up into the roof space, where a vertical 'Cavity barrier E 30 and EI 15' separates the roof space over the stairway from the rest of the roof.

In b., the stairway's enclosure stops at the top storey's ceiling, and a 'Fire resisting ceiling EI 30' runs across the whole top of the house, over both the rooms and the stairway, below the unoccupied roof space.
model_description:
This diagram, titled "Alternative cavity barrier arrangements in roof space over protected stairway in a", shows two cross-sectional drawings, labelled a. and b., illustrating different cavity barrier configurations.

In drawing a., a protected stairway is shown on the right, enclosed by a "Fire resisting enclosure to protected stairway REI 30". Above this is an "Unoccupied space". A "Cavity barrier E 30 and EI 15" is positioned horizontally, separating the unoccupied space from the area above the stairway. A dimension of "4.5m" indicates the height from the floor to the ceiling level.

In drawing b., the configuration differs. The "Protected stairway" remains enclosed by a "Fire resisting enclosure to protected stairway REI 30". However, instead of a cavity barrier, there is a "Fire resisting ceiling EI 30" separating the stairway from the "Unoccupied space" above. This drawing also includes a "4.5m" dimension for the height. A note at the top left of the entire diagram states "See para 2.5".
